four_authority_acts: R7 vocabulary owner or separately verified formal delegate completes and ratifies the exact seven-target algebra.
Host authority signs recommendation, execution and adoption boundaries.
Target-corpus rights holder grants the exact storage, processing, adjudication, quotation and release rights.
Eligible adapter-independent semantic reviewer signs a content-addressed CONFORMANT review.
ordered_external_execution: An external delegator supplies a separately verifiable R7 vocabulary-ownership basis and signs the exact seven-target delegation; the named delegate signs acceptance.

Before semantic work, the delegate and reviewer sign no-prior-adapter-access attestations. Administrative signing forms may be delivered, but the semantic input set remains exactly the three V10 allowlisted artifacts plus independently retrieved primary public standards.
The delegate signs receipt of the exact three allowlisted hashes, completes the exact seven-target ratifiable payload and signs its RFC8785 canonical SHA-256 under the ALGEBRA_PAYLOAD domain.

After the payload hash is sealed, the independent reviewer receives only that payload, allowlisted target-side artifacts and primary public standards, then signs the content-addressed review and delivery receipt.

The delegate constructs the final schema-conformant V8 instance by adding ratification that binds the signed payload hash and signed review hash, then content-addresses and signs the final envelope separately.
Host authority and target-corpus rights holder sign their separate content-addressed records over the final envelope; neither act is inferred from owner delegation or repository licensing.
Every signature and key identity is verified; every digest is committed before any adapter-side artifact is unsealed.
Only a completely signed, internally consistent bundle authorizes the unchanged 117,649-map audit.

pass_rule.adapter_blind_custody: Both stage-A no-prior-access receipts and the stage-B reviewer delivery receipt are signed, hash-consistent and precede adapter unsealing.
pass_rule.algebra: Exactly seven unique required decision IDs occupy the RFC8785-canonical ratifiable payload; its ALGEBRA_PAYLOAD hash is owner/delegate signed, reviewed, inserted into final V8 ratification, and the final schema-conformant envelope is separately hashed and signed.
pass_rule.delegation: All seven target IDs, both completion and ratification powers, delegator ownership basis, delegator signature, delegate acceptance, effective time and revocation rule are bound.
pass_rule.host_and_rights: Separate verified authorities sign exact host boundaries and exact target-corpus rights over content-addressed bytes.
pass_rule.independent_review: A reviewer independent of the candidate-author and adapter lanes signs a CONFORMANT review of the sealed algebra hash.
pass_rule.noncompensatory: All conjuncts pass; no field, signature, role or act compensates for another.

prohibitions: No candidate-author or AI fabrication of external names, ownership bases, signatures, keys, delegations, acceptance, rights, review or custody.
No inference of R7 ownership from repository ownership, issue authorship, employment, task assignment or open-source licensing.
No semantic input beyond the exact V10 allowlist plus independently retrieved primary public standards before algebra commitment.
No P1 source profiles, crosswalks, compatibility rows, survivor maps, audit results, cases, labels, models, scores or outcomes delivered before commitment.
No map-audit rerun, case or outcome access, pytest, repository CI, manuscript, shared ledger, Git history or other-lane edit.
No completion claim from an unsigned template or provider-ready packet.
scientific_question: Can the V12 causal authority gap be converted into one externally executable, content-addressed and adapter-blind signing packet without fabricating any authority or repeating public metadata probes?
